### Department of Mathematics — Aristotle University of Thessaloniki

**BSc in Mathematics** · 2019–2024

Thessaloniki, Greece

Graduated with **7.91/10**, ranking **13th among 137 graduates**. My undergraduate project applied Markov chain theory and R to patterns of cancer metastasis.
